name.text: W04_Q01: Cultural and Creative Arts JSS1 Assessment

questiontext.text: What are the Principles of Art and Design?

generalfeedback.text: Principles are the organizational rules governing how elements are combined.

answer.text: The physical tools used to carve wood

feedback.text: Incorrect. Principles are the organizational rules governing how elements are combined.

answer.text: The organizational rules and guidelines that govern how elements of art are arranged to create successful compositions

feedback.text: Correct! Principles are the organizational rules governing how elements are combined.

answer.text: The laws passed by the government to tax paintings

feedback.text: Incorrect. Principles are the organizational rules governing how elements are combined.

answer.text: The chemical formulas used to mix oil paints

feedback.text: Incorrect. Principles are the organizational rules governing how elements are combined.

name.text: W04_Q02: Cultural and Creative Arts JSS1 Assessment

questiontext.text: In the classic analogy of baking, if the Elements of Art are the raw ingredients, what are the Principles of Art?

generalfeedback.text: Elements are ingredients; Principles are the organizational recipe.

feedback.text: Incorrect. Elements are ingredients; Principles are the organizational recipe.

answer.text: The recipe and cooking method that organizes and balances the ingredients

feedback.text: Correct! Elements are ingredients; Principles are the organizational recipe.

answer.text: The price charged for the cake in a bakery

feedback.text: Incorrect. Elements are ingredients; Principles are the organizational recipe.
Incorrect. Elements are ingredients; Principles are the organizational recipe.

name.text: W04_Q03: Cultural and Creative Arts JSS1 Assessment

questiontext.text: What is "Balance" in a visual artwork?

generalfeedback.text: Balance is the visual equilibrium and distribution of weight.

answer.text: The physical weight of the wooden frame on a scale

feedback.text: Incorrect. Balance is the visual equilibrium and distribution of weight.

answer.text: The visual distribution of weight and equilibrium across a composition

feedback.text: Correct! Balance is the visual equilibrium and distribution of weight.

answer.text: Painting only with black and white paint

feedback.text: Incorrect. Balance is the visual equilibrium and distribution of weight.

answer.text: Drawing an exact circle with a compass

feedback.text: Incorrect. Balance is the visual equilibrium and distribution of weight.

name.text: W04_Q04: Cultural and Creative Arts JSS1 Assessment

questiontext.text: What type of balance occurs when elements on both sides of a central axis mirror each other almost identically?

generalfeedback.text: Symmetrical balance features mirror-image equality across an axis.

feedback.text: Incorrect. Symmetrical balance features mirror-image equality across an axis.
Correct! Symmetrical balance features mirror-image equality across an axis.
Incorrect. Symmetrical balance features mirror-image equality across an axis.
Incorrect. Symmetrical balance features mirror-image equality across an axis.

name.text: W04_Q05: Cultural and Creative Arts JSS1 Assessment

questiontext.text: What type of balance is achieved when two sides are visually different yet maintain visual equilibrium through placement, size, and color?

generalfeedback.text: Asymmetrical balance achieves equilibrium using unequal, distinct elements.

feedback.text: Incorrect. Asymmetrical balance achieves equilibrium using unequal, distinct elements.
Correct! Asymmetrical balance achieves equilibrium using unequal, distinct elements.
Incorrect. Asymmetrical balance achieves equilibrium using unequal, distinct elements.
Incorrect. Asymmetrical balance achieves equilibrium using unequal, distinct elements.

name.text: W04_Q06: Cultural and Creative Arts JSS1 Assessment

questiontext.text: What type of balance radiates outward in all directions from a central focal point like sunflower petals or a bicycle wheel?

name.text: W04_Q07: Cultural and Creative Arts JSS1 Assessment

questiontext.text: What is "Proportion" in visual arts?

generalfeedback.text: Proportion governs the size relationships of parts to one another and the whole.

feedback.text: Incorrect. Proportion governs the size relationships of parts to one another and the whole.

answer.text: The comparative size and scale relationship of parts to each other and to the whole artwork

feedback.text: Correct! Proportion governs the size relationships of parts to one another and the whole.

feedback.text: Incorrect. Proportion governs the size relationships of parts to one another and the whole.
Incorrect. Proportion governs the size relationships of parts to one another and the whole.

name.text: W04_Q08: Cultural and Creative Arts JSS1 Assessment

questiontext.text: Why did traditional Yoruba sculptors intentionally carve human figures with proportionally massive heads (often one-third of the body)?

generalfeedback.text: In Yoruba sculpture, large heads symbolize *Ori* (spiritual destiny and intellect).

answer.text: Because they did not know how to measure bodies

feedback.text: Incorrect. In Yoruba sculpture, large heads symbolize *Ori* (spiritual destiny and intellect).

answer.text: To express the philosophical and spiritual importance of "Ori" as the seat of personal destiny and wisdom

feedback.text: Correct! In Yoruba sculpture, large heads symbolize *Ori* (spiritual destiny and intellect).

answer.text: Because wood was scarce in ancient times

feedback.text: Incorrect. In Yoruba sculpture, large heads symbolize *Ori* (spiritual destiny and intellect).

answer.text: To make the statues heavier on the floor

feedback.text: Incorrect. In Yoruba sculpture, large heads symbolize *Ori* (spiritual destiny and intellect).

questiontext.text: In art and design, Line, Shape, and Color are classified as Principles of Art.

generalfeedback.text: False. Line, Shape, and Color are *Elements* of Art. Balance, Contrast, and Proportion are *Principles*.

Correct. False. Line, Shape, and Color are *Elements* of Art. Balance, Contrast, and Proportion are *Principles*.

name.text: W04_Q17: Cultural and Creative Arts JSS1 Assessment

questiontext.text: Which of the following are recognized Principles of Art and Design? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: Balance, Proportion, and Contrast are principles. Texture is an element.

name.text: W04_Q18: Cultural and Creative Arts JSS1 Assessment

questiontext.text: Which of the following are the three primary forms of Visual Balance? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: Symmetrical, Asymmetrical, and Radial are the three visual balance types.

generalfeedback.text: Balance=weight; Proportion=scale; Contrast=opposition; Dominance=focal point.
